title: Predicates
description: The claim-check predicate library v0.1 as data: name, parameters after the subject (names and Param types), polarity and window of every predicate (03 §7, 06 §3.5). Maintained by the lead in contracts/predicates.json; parameter ranges stay in config/faultloom.yaml and weights in config/causentra.yaml (lead decisions §2.6).

predicates.description: Every library predicate, sorted by name.

PredicateSpec.description: One library predicate. The subject service is implied as the first argument and never listed in params (03 §7, §9.1).

params.description: Arguments after the subject, in call order (03 §7); may be empty.

polarity.description: supports or refutes the subject being the root (03 §7); must equal the code polarity of the registered predicate.

window.description: Window written on the predicate's claim_check atoms (contract_changes B: claim_check window = Predicate.window).

PredicateParam.description: One predicate argument: its name and FaultLoom Param type (03 §7, 06 §3.5).

type.description: Param type: float, int, service (a graph.nodes.node) or signal (a signal present in the case's signal_cube.series), as in 03 §7.
